interface.showInlineTitleDesc: Show the note title as an editable title at the top of each note.
interface.showTabTitleBarDesc: Display the header at the top of every tab.
interface.showStatusBarDesc: Show the word, character, and backlink count in the bottom right corner.
interface.showRibbonDesc: Display vertical toolbar on the side of the window.
interface.ribbonConfigDesc: Configure what commands appear in the ribbon menu.
interface.ribbonModalDesc: Choose which items to show on the left ribbon. Drag or use the buttons to change their order.
interface.windowFrameStyleDesc: Determines the styling of the title bar of Urano windows. Requires a full restart to take effect.
interface.translucentWindowDesc: Turn on translucency effect to enhance a sense of depth. Best used with dark mode. Not supported on Linux.
interface.zoomLevelDesc: Controls the overall zoom level of the app.
interface.nativeMenusDesc: Menus throughout the app will match the operating system. They will not be affected by your theme.
interface.openSettingsInNewWindowDesc: Open settings in their own window instead of integrating them into the app.

editor.defaultViewModeDesc: The default view that a new Markdown tab gets opened in.
editor.defaultEditingModeDesc: The default editing mode a new tab will start with.
editor.editorStatusDesc: Show the editor status in the status bar and a button to switch editor modes.
editor.showInlineTitleDesc: Display the filename as an editable title inline with the file contents.
editor.readableLineLengthDesc: Limit maximum line length. Less content fits onscreen, but long blocks of text are more readable.
editor.strictLineBreaksDesc: Markdown specs ignore single line breaks in reading view. Turn this off to make single line breaks visible.
editor.propertiesInDocumentDesc: Choose how properties are displayed at the top of notes. Select "Source" to show properties as raw YAML.
editor.foldHeadingDesc: Lets you fold all content under a heading.
editor.foldIndentDesc: Lets you fold part of an indentation, such as lists.
editor.showLineNumbersDesc: Show line numbers in the gutter.
editor.indentGuidesDesc: Show vertical relationship lines between list items.
editor.rightToLeftDesc: Sets the default text direction of notes to right-to-left.
editor.smartIndentDesc: Automatically set indentation and place list items correctly.
editor.useTabsDesc: Use tabs to indent by pressing the “Tab” key. Turn this off to indent using spaces.
editor.tabSizeDesc: Number of spaces a tab character will render as.
editor.autoPairMarkdownDesc: Pair symbols automatically for bold, italic, code, and more.
editor.autoConvertHtmlDesc: Automatically convert HTML to Markdown when pasting and drag-and-drop from web pages. Use Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V to paste HTML without converting.
editor.vimModeDesc: Use Vim key bindings when editing.

files.defaultFileToOpenDesc: Choose which file to open when the app starts.

files.newLinkFormatDesc: What links to insert when auto-generating internal links.
files.alwaysUpdateLinksDesc: Turn off to be prompted to update links after renaming a file.
files.useWikilinksDesc: Auto-generate Wikilinks for [[links]] and ![[images]] instead of Markdown links and images. Disable this option to generate Markdown links instead.
files.detectAllFileExtensionsDesc: Show files with any extension even if Urano can't open them natively, so you can link to them and see them in File Explorer and Quick Switcher.
files.detectAllFileTypesDesc: Show files with any extension even if Urano cannot open them natively.
files.deleteAttachmentsWithFileDesc: Automatically remove attachments linked to the deleted file if they're not used elsewhere.

files.excludedFilesModalDesc: Excluded files will be hidden in search, quick switcher, and graph view.
